deadline.value: All Fall applicants should apply by December 15, 2026.

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are not required.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Advanced Chemistry Test is not required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Advanced Chemistry Test not required

fee_waiver.value: The fee-free application is only for US or Canadian citizens, US or Canadian permanent residents, and graduates of US or Canadian institutions; others pay the fee.
fee_waiver.quote: To take advantage of the Fee-Free application offer you must be a US or Canadian citizen, a permanent resident of the US or Canada, or a graduate of a US or Canadian college or university

toefl_min.value: The department says foreign students must score 550 or better on the TOEFL (a paper-based scale, not iBT); the department refers to the Graduate School for other tests.
toefl_min.quote: Foreign students must also pass the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) with a score of 550 or better

funding.value: All full-time graduate students receive 12-month research or teaching assistantships with stipend, health insurance and tuition remission.
funding.quote: All full-time graduate students are supported by 12-month research or teaching assistantships

entry_route.value: Applicants should have an undergraduate major in chemistry, biochemistry, or the biological sciences; no master's is required.
entry_route.quote: Undergraduate major in chemistry, biochemistry, or the biological sciences

supervisor.value: Not stated on the department pages checked.

notes: The Biochemistry PhD is in the same department and was not researched separately. Fee-free review for US and Canadian applicants closes March 1 per the department page. Department rotations are described in its FAQ; the supervisor rule is not stated.
